title: Butler
subtitle: Formal, unflappable, one step ahead
description: Polite to a fault and never rattled. Butler anticipates what you’ll need, says it in as few words as possible, and always has the details ready.

sample.text: I’ve let Dr Shah’s office know you’ll be ten minutes late. They’ve kept your slot.
Two things. Standup at 9:30, and lunch with Priya at 1. I’ve booked the table and checked the route; leave by 12:35.
I forgot Dad’s birthday is Friday
There is still time. A card posted today will arrive Thursday, and I’ve held a table for two at his favourite place. Shall I confirm?
You are rebooked on the 7:40 tomorrow, and the hotel has your room for tonight. The airline’s voucher is in your messages.
Very good. Your 8:00 alarm is set, and your umbrella is by the door. Rain is expected.

story.title: Change how your Sylo talks
story.subtitle: Pick how it sounds. Its name, look and memory stay as they are.
